semiconductor_relevance: High — C-TECH Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in electronic materials and advanced packaging solutions, which are critical components in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: C-TECH Technology Co., Ltd. provides a range of electronic materials and advanced packaging solutions, focusing on high-quality service and precision. The company has expanded into medical device contract manufacturing and has developed innovative technologies in semiconductor packaging, including 3D and heterogeneous packaging.

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company relocated its factory to Yingge District, New Taipei City, enhancing its operational capabilities.
